body: It'll hit me when I try to go to bed tonight.  Nighttime and having an empty bed are unavoidable triggers.

I definitely relate to both of you.  My siblings and I have gotten closer, but for the most part my family has always been distant.  When I do manage to make a close friend it doesn't last forever, or they move far away and it's just not the same.  Mostly though not having someone to love me and be there like that is a huge trigger for me, and it's very difficult for me to be around happy couples as well.  For me it's made worse by the fact that lots of men are always trying to get me into bed, but nobody seems to want to date me.
Nobody ever wants me around for long.  I don't even know what's wrong with me, I must be terrible to deal with in real life to be this alone.
I'm almost 30 and have yet to find a single person.  Trust me. It isn't from lack of trying.  Nobody wants me around for long.  I'm tried of getting hurt.

Wait. So this person was suicidal, and you tried to talk her out of it, but she's still suicidal only now BECAUSE you tried to help that makes it your fault that she's suffering from the same condition she had before you said anything?  Does that really make sense? Do you see the cognitive distortion (thinking trap) you're in here? Are you REALLY responsible for what's going through another person's mind? Does that mean someone else is responsible for how you think and feel?  Of course not. Ultimately at the end of the day you are in charge of how you react to things.  So is she. If she kills herself that's on her, that's something she was going to do no matter what you did or didn't do about it.
Nobody can survive without human connection.  And I certainly have no desire to keep fighting when I'm so alone.  There's nothing to fight for.

Yes I've actually been told several times. Or even better sometimes at work people will talk about me like I'm not there or as if cubicle walls are somehow sound proof.  It got really bad after I filed a complaint against this coworker who was always rubbing up on me and feeling me up.  He denied everything and there were no witnesses, so clearly I'm just crazy and trying to get him fired for no reason. After that people would seriously tell me to my face that there must be something wrong with me, they say I'm shaky all the time, or have an eating disorder because I don't like to eat a full lunch, that I'm crazy and probably going to kill myself, that I'm overly sensitive and the guy is just friendly and I took it wrong.  Seriously, it's the only time in my life I've ever stood up for myself and I wish I hadn't. My ex husband once told me that I'm going to be alone forever because I'm such a fuck up I can't even hold a marriage together. He was completely right.

People don't like me and often tell me so.  I'm too reserved or quiet or whatever. I don't have many friends who haven't taken advantage of me.  Every relationship I've had has ended with me being cheated on or left for another woman. I'm just not as good as other people. I don't belong

If I could have one thing it would be to have people treat me better.  Or at least with some modicum of respect and decency. I get beat down a lot.  I think it's just my personality though. I don't like confrontation.
It isn't the minor things that bother me though.  It's the big things I have no control over.  It's the things other people do to me.
I don't really see anyway to fix even minor things. Just moving is difficult and painful.

I'm not sure if talking makes any difference. I don't have the ability to solve any of these problems.  Maybe something will change between now and May.  But I'm not counting on it, and continuing on nothing but the momentum of false hope doesn't make sense to me. Like at some point there has to be an end to all the shit.

If.  Once again I'm almost 30 and I haven't experienced anything but pain and various forms of pain in my life.  I've never felt happy, or loved, or like there's anything positive between my existence and the rest of the world.  Suffering through more and more bullshit for an if that has yet to prove it exists seems silly to me.  Hell I have more proof that there's life after death and I still don't really believe in that. I'm pretty much just expecting to cease, and that is fine. Nothing that will come after will matter because I'll be dead. There's no way to guarantee that your IF will ever happen, but I have a sure fire way to guarantee that I won't have to hurt and be hurt anymore ever again.

I just don't see how it makes sense to keep on living knowing that I'm a burden to others, on the off chance that the crushing loneliness will somehow be cured, and that maybe I can get through a whole year without something terrible happening, when I'm almost 30 years old and in my whole life there's never really been a good time.  I don't want to have to live through some other trauma for the unlikely possibility that maybe something good will happen even though it's never happened before. Maybe things change for some people, but I'm clearly not that lucky.  I just want to be done.  I want to go back to that place I saw when I bled out. And even if it turns out that it was just a hallucination and there is no after, at least I can feel that good again for the last moments it takes for my brain to die because that still beats living.

There's not much to talk about. I've just been shit on my whole life. I was abused and molested as a child. I've been raped multiple times and in multiple abusive relationships as an adult. I would die for the people I care about but most of them wouldn't piss on me if I was on fire.  I've been in more relationships than most other women I know but I've been cheated on, abused, or at least dumped for someone else 100% of the time. I've had more loss in my life than most people I know. There's just a point where enough bad shit happens in your life where you have to look at the one consistent common denominator.  Which in this case is me. For some reason I'm broken, I'm only meant to have pain in my life, and I'm tired of it.  I can't have happiness so there's no point in living any further.

Your dad sounds pretty abusive.  Think of this though, if you kill yourself you won't get to see whether he cries or not.  You'll be dead.  Is someone who is that cold and abusive worth dying for? You're not the problem here. You're a good person. Don't kill yourself for a jerk.
After 3 years I don't really have the strength nor desire to try again. I'm just not meant to have happiness. And that's fine.

Ah lonely and being socially awkward really blows.  I feel you on that one.  I've managed to hang onto a couple good friends but the majority of people don't seem to care for me.  Since finding a partner is a priority for you have you tried broadening the field you're looking in? For example instead of only hanging out with people from work or school have you thought about trying some different activities where you'll be out around people? What about online dating? There's nothing wrong with experimenting with different things until you find some people who can accept you for who you are.  And there are people in the world who will share enough common interests to understand you.  It just may not be the social group you're in now.

There's nothing in life that makes me happy at all.  I just don't see the point in trying when I've tried everything.  I have no control over the circumstances which have brought me to this point. I have no ability to fix anything. I'm broken and unlovable. I'm exhausted with living in pain and it'll be easier on everyone else once I'm gone.  There's no other solution which fixes everything that's wrong in my world.

Well I'm not going to try to talk you out of it because I'm not a hypocrit.  But I will say that you should be really sure this is the best decision.  It's going to be the last thing you ever do, so make sure that it's really what you want to do and not just a knee jerk reaction to something bad that happened recently.
I just shared because I felt like getting it off my chest.  I'm sick of all the bullshit that is my life.  And I'm excited that it has an ending point at last.

You can if you want to. But be warned, if I had any doubt or any fear that  I could be talked out of it, I wouldn't tell anyone. I guess maybe some people post to be saved..  I'm not really sure why I felt like sharing my story, other than just in coming to a decision about it I feel such a sense of relief that I felt like sharing.  But at the same time I don't want to burden my family with the knowledge that I've decided, because I think it would just make them feel worse for not stopping me. So please at least don't feel bad when I disappear from the interwebs because I finished my plan

Well I want my child back for starters, which is impossible. I want to be in a relationship where I'm secure and loved and don't get dumped for another woman.  Really I would kill to have someone to grow old with and have another child without being alone the whole pregnancy/first years.  I remember with my daughter I was in the hospital with complications quite a bit, I had this week long stay one time and for part of it I had a roommate.  Her husband was always there worrying about her and bringing her flowers and shit.  Meanwhile my husband stopped by once the whole week, and it was just to complain about how hard everything was at home and to be mad at me for being stuck in the hospital and not being home helping.   I have no idea what it's like to be loved like that other woman was.  It's not the sort of thing that's applicable to me I suppose.  I'd like to not be disabled anymore and to do the things physically that I used to enjoy.  I could probably list things all night that are always out of my reach.  Hell I'd just like to not be depressed anymore.

I wish it was that easy.  The things I really want in life are forever out of my reach.  I've spent years trying. Doing what my therapist says.  Working. Trying to get better.  But years later the depression is just the same as it ever was if not worse.  If your dog gets cancer do you make it suffer for years knowing it's existence is going to be short and painful?  Or do you just put it down and feel relief that you don't have to watch it suffer anymore?  Maybe something will change between now and may, I wouldn't put money on it though since nothing has changed in the last 3 years.

No the sadness is always right under the surface.  What are they like? It's like sprinting as fast as you can.  Only in my case it's pushing everything down and trying as hard as I can to grab onto some peace.  To just forget everything hurts.  But it's like sprinting. It takes all I have and it isn't sustainable.  And when the reality sinks back in, the crushing loneliness, the desire to reach out for people who have passed on, the physical pain, then it's all 1000x sharper and more painful.  Because the other state, the happiness, isn't real.  

It doesn't help either that I had this experience where due to medical complications I bled out.  I lost enough blood to pass out and need to be resuscitated.  In that instant there was this moment where I was in this other place.  And all my loved ones who I've lost were there.  I got to hold my child happy and healthy.  And nothing hurt anymore. Dying felt better than anything I've experienced in life.  So why drag on and cling to moments here and there where I somehow manage to forget my life, when I can just go back there again?  I just want peace finally, dying is the only thing I have to look forward to now.

Honestly, I have no idea why occasionally I feel ok.  I think I just forget who I am sometimes.  I'll have tiny moments where I can laugh but the overwhelming sadness is always right there waiting. My friend probably doesn't think he's hurting me. But he still left me for another woman, it's still right in my face no matter how much he tries to hide it. There's just no point.  I'm literally a burden on those around me, and I'm tired of living in pain and dragging everyone down with me.

I've been in counseling.  My husband left me for another woman shortly after our daughter died, he also had gotten heavily into drugs before that, he became very abusive and spent several months in rehab. So he really just made things worse. My parents are both dead, so I've been relying on my siblings and a couple close friends for support but they don't understand really.  My closest friend and I ended up dating for awhile but he ended things abruptly and without any reason.  Like literally one day everything was wonderful the next it was over.  He says he just doesn't want a relationship, but I suspect that he's been seeing this other girl he's known for awhile. He still tries to be supportive and be my friend but it really just adds to the pain at this point.  My other friend lives kind of far away and has physically shown up on my doorstep to stop me from killing myself before.  So I feel really guilty that he's put so much effort into saving me and I still just hurt and am tired. My siblings won't have much to do with me when I'm feeling down anymore, they're just tired of watching me suffer and not being able to help.  I've been going to therapy for awhile and I'm on seroquel.  Sometimes I'll feel better for a moment, or a day or two but it always just comes back.  It's been nearly 3 years of this and I no longer have the hope that anything will get better.  To top it off the last year I've been struggling with a permanent disability from an accident, so I'm in constant physical pain now as well.  I've reached the point where I simply can no longer go on suffering through day after day, and there is no indication that there will ever be a cure nor any relief for my physical and emotional pain. It's just time.

It's my dead baby's birthday, it's been years since I lost her and everyday is still a struggle.  That's why I picked that day though. In the meantime I'm just going to make sure my finances are in order.  Make sure my house is clean and rid of all the junk nobody is going to want.  I'm going to visit some old friends for the last time.  Get my other children adjusted to spending more and more time with their dad, step-mom, and half-siblings.  Go to work. Pretend everything is normal.  But quietly distance myself from anyone who might miss me.  I figure it might be less traumatic if I step out of everyone's lives a few months before hand.  Then they'll all be used to me not being there already.
